title: Microlocal analysis of Radon transforms over quadric surfaces
summary: We study the microlocal properties of generalized Radon transforms over a family of quadric hypersurfaces whose centers lie on an orientable hypersurface $S$. The quadric surfaces we consider are level sets of the quadratic form associated to a symmetric, invertible matrix $A$, with real entries. We study the singularities of the right and left projections of the canonical relation associated with these operators and show that they are determined by the signature of the matrix $A$ and the hypersurface $S$.
